name: purple worm
desc: Purple Worm is a CR 15 monstrosity.

actions.name: tunneler
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes two attacks: one with its [[/item .dlzFJ5UjbMAfJ6Sb]]{bite} and one with its [[/item .yOjkK3f9jt2fYu3M]]{stinger}.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a [[/save activity=dnd5eactivity100]] saving throw or be swallowed by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. A swallowed creature is &reference[blinded] and &reference[restrained], it has &reference[total cover] against attacks and other effects outside the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, and it takes [[/damage average activity=5Ch92u8uWNihu5p1]] damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save activity=RtTQzkfIp3upqvoQ]] saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall &reference[prone] in a space within 10 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting &reference[prone].

actions.name: tail stinger
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The target must make a [[/save activity=IKUzECPGj8QbMFLo]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=IKUzECPGj8QbMFLo]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
